AWS CLF-C02 Practice Test

Question 1

Which AWS service provides object storage with virtually unlimited scalability and high durability?

  • A. Amazon EBS
  • B. Amazon S3
  • C. Amazon EFS
  • D. AWS Storage Gateway

Correct Answer: B

Explanation: Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) is an object storage service offering industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance.

Question 2

Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, which security task is the customer responsible for performing?

  • A. Physical data center access controls
  • B. Operating system patching and updates on Amazon EC2
  • C. Virtualization hypervisor maintenance
  • D. Decommissioning storage drives

Correct Answer: B

Explanation: Customers are responsible for managing guest operating systems, application software, and firewall configurations.
